lines: 这里不是我的宿舍……
This isn't my dorm room...
我到底到了什么地方？
Where on earth am I?
万象系统已觉醒。
The Myriad System has awakened.
完成词汇挑战，获得金币。
Complete vocabulary challenges to earn coins.
金币可购买装备、道具与技能。
Spend coins on equipment, items and skills.
部署支援能力，帮助异世界中的伙伴。
Deploy support abilities to help people in other worlds.
我穿越了……还得背单词？
Another world... and I still have to study words?
警告：本地身份记录缺失。
Warning: no local identity record found.
等等……它在扫描我！
Wait... it's scanning me!
身后忽然响起急促的脚步声。
Rapid footsteps suddenly sound behind me.
别站在那里！跟我走！
Don't stand there! Come with me!
你没有身份记录，对吧？
You don't have an identity record, do you?
首次支援目标确认：陈星遥。
First support target confirmed: Chen Xingyao.
第一卷 · 霓虹失名者
Volume I: The Nameless of Neon
